info.title: EPG Licensing - New Regulation API (one call)
info.description: Catalogue + one-call application API under the delivery-activities regulation. Step 1: GET the catalogue. Step 2: POST one composite call that creates the company, owners, signatory, application, declarations, child items and documents together. Generated from the NewLaw sandbox catalogue on 2026-10-22T06:29:51Z.

post.description: Send grant_type=client_credentials with the client id and secret of the External Client App. Use access_token as Bearer token on every other call. Tokens expire after about two hours.

client_id.description: Consumer key of the External Client App

client_secret.description: Consumer secret of the External Client App

get.summary: GET whole catalogue, or one licence product with ?code=
get.description: Returns every active licence product with everything the portal must show and collect for it: the name in English and Arabic, the fee rows, the list of documents with their rules (required or optional, condition, accepted formats, size limits, whether an expiry date is needed), the extra fields the application form must ask for, and which extra items to send with the application (storage site, locker site, operator contract). The portal builds the licence selection page and the application form from this answer: when a product is added in Salesforce it appears here, and on the portal, with no portal release. With ?code=<Product_Code> the same shape is returned for that product only; the portal uses it once the applicant has chosen a licence and the form page needs only that product.

parameters.description: Omit for the whole catalogue; a product code for that product only

post.summary: Create the company and its application with all documents in one call
post.description:
Items run in order inside one transaction and may reference earlier items with @{referenceId.id}. 1 Account (matched by trade licence number: created or updated), 2 Beneficial owners (matched by identifier), 3 Contact = signatory (matched by UAE PASS id), 4 License Request (Product_Code; created in Draft, fee quoted, document slots created), 5 Application Item declarations, 6 child items the product needs (site / operator contract), 7 one Document item per slot. With allOrNone=true any refused item rolls back the whole submission. Status 200 is returned even when items failed: read body.success and body.errors per item.

Application id: issued by Salesforce (the LR number) and returned as body.applicationId on the application item; never send one on a create. Idempotency: the trade licence number (EPG_Trade_license_no__c) is the key of the company; a create re-sent for a company and product that already have an open application (Draft / Pending Payment) returns that application, so a retry after a timeout never creates a second one. To update an application later, send applicationId__c = the returned id; an id Salesforce did not issue, or one belonging to another company, is refused.

About the examples: they are the exact bodies that were run successfully against the NewLaw sandbox. Executing one from Swagger UI or Postman creates (or, on a second run, updates) the sample company "Sample Courier Co LLC" (trade licence TL-SAMPLE-0001) and one application per product, whose id is returned in the response. Change the trade licence number to create your own test company.

post.summary: Quote an application from the licence catalogue (step 3)
post.description: Existing pricing endpoint, extended: for a new-regulation application it answers from Draft onwards with the quote the Fee Calculator derives from the catalogue, one item per fee line (base fee, per-site / per-locker / per-vehicle components, discounts). While the application is still editable and unpaid (Draft, Pending Payment) the quote is recalculated on each call, so a fee changed on the licence product is reflected before payment; once paid the quote is frozen. The amount to pay is the sum of items[].totalAmount. 404 when the application id is unknown or the application is closed (rejected, revoked, closed). Legacy applications keep the previous behaviour of this endpoint.

byApplicationId.summary: Quote by the applicationId the create response returned (expected per product: CEP30-UAE-SME-DOM 1000 AED; CEP30-UAE-SME-INTL 2000 AED; CEP30-NONUAE-SME-DOM 5000 AED; CEP30-NONUAE-SME-INTL 10000 AED; CEP30-GEN-DOM 20000 AED; CEP30-GEN-INTL 40000 AED; FOODMED 500 AED; INTERMED 5000 AED; LOCKERS 1000 AED; OUTSOURCE no fee)

get.description: The external system may call this at any time with the application id. For a new-regulation application the answer carries its three statuses: requestStatus (the working status staff see), applicantStatus (the status the applicant may see, bilingual) and paymentStatus (Unpaid or Paid), with the current step, the team holding it, the pre-check result, any open information request with what was asked, the document slots and their validation, the fee quote and payment advice, the decision once taken and the licence once issued. The legacy envelope and decision node are kept; legacy applications keep the previous behaviour.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The applicationId returned by the create response (LR-xxxxx)

404.description: Unknown application id (body: status 404 with a bilingual reason)

Fee.description: One fee row of the product. The quote is the sum of the rows that match the application.

feeType.description: Application fee | Annual fee | Per-locker fee | Discount ...

unit.description: Flat | Per site | Per locker | Per vehicle | Percent of base

amount.description: AED, or a percentage when unit is Percent of base

tier.description: Tier the row applies to; null = any

scope.description: Scope the row applies to; null = any

DocumentRequirement.description: One document the product asks for. The portal shows the list and validates uploads against these rules; the server validates again.

documentType.description: Send this exact value as Document_Type on the document item

required.description: true = must be uploaded before submission; false = optional

requiredWhen.description: Always | Food declared | Medicine declared | Food or medicine declared | International scope | SME sub-category | Insurance supplied. A slot is only created when the condition holds for the application.

minSizeKb.description: Minimum size in KB (rejects empty files); null = none

validityRequired.description: true = Valid_To__c (expiry) must be sent with the file

validityMustCoverLicence.description: true = the expiry must cover the whole licence term

templateKey.description: Template the applicant downloads and fills, when EPGL supplies one

ApplicationField.description: A field the application form must collect for this product, beyond the company and owner data.

type.description: string | number | boolean | picklist | datetime | object

description.description: What to collect; "on the Application Item" means it goes in the Application_Item__c item

ChildItem.description: An extra composite item the product expects in the same call.

fields.description: Fields to send, with fixed values where shown

Product.description: One licence product: everything the portal must show and collect for it.

code.description: Product_Code to send on the application

activityCode.description: Article 5 activity whose rules the product runs (CEP30, FOODMED, INTERMED, LOCKERS, OUTSOURCE)

eligibleTiers.description: Tiers (Article 7) a company may hold this product in

tier.description: Tier fixed by the product (the six CEP cases); null when the product spans tiers

scope.description: Domestic | Domestic and International; null when not fixed

requiresCepLicence.description: true = the company must already hold an active CEP licence (permits)

applicationFeeApplies.description: false = no application fee, submission skips payment

conditionalIssuance.description: true = licence issued conditionally pending inspection/verification

parameters.description: Global parameters: SLA working days, online payment threshold, document max size

products.description: All active products, in display order (one entry when ?code= is used)

body.description: One of the item bodies below, with "sObject" implied by the url

OneCallRequest.description: Company, owners, signatory, application, declarations, child items and documents in one transaction, in this order.

allOrNone.description: true = any failed item rolls back every item

id.description: Salesforce id of the created/updated record

applicationId.description: On the application item only: the application id Salesforce issued (LR-xxxxx). Use it for documents, pricing, status, information request and licence retrieval.

errors.description: Human-readable reasons when success is false

AccountItem.description: The applying company. Matched by EPG_Trade_license_no__c: created when unknown, updated otherwise. Later items reference it as @{NewAccount.id}.

EPG_Regulator__c.example: Dubai - Department of Economy and Tourism

BeneficialOwnerItem.description: One item per real beneficiary (Cabinet Resolution 58/2020). Matched by Account__c + Identifier__c.

ContactItem.description: The authorised signatory as a Contact of the company, matched by UId__c (UAE PASS id) within the company.

LicenseRequestItem.description: The application. Product_Code selects the product; the server creates it in Draft, quotes the fee, creates the document slots and issues the application id (the LR number), returned as body.applicationId on this item in the response. Do not send applicationId__c on a create: an id Salesforce did not issue is refused. Send it only to update an application already created. A create re-sent for a company and product that already have an open application (Draft / Pending Payment) returns that application instead of a second one.

applicationId__c.description: Only on an update: the applicationId returned by the create response (LR-xxxxx)

isAgent_Request__c.description: true when the submission comes through the agent / assistant channel (audit trail, returned as agentRequest in the status)

Form_Data.description: Any answers without a dedicated field

Principal_Licence_Number.description: LOCKERS (optional) / OUTSOURCE (required): licence number of the principal CEP licensee

ApplicationItemItem.description: Declarations of the application (License_Request__c = @{NewLicenseRequest.id}). Updates the item the server created with the application.

Outsourced_Activities__c.description: OUTSOURCE, semicolon list of activity codes

ApplicationSiteItem.description: FOODMED storage premises or LOCKERS locker/PUDO site. Matched by License_Request__c + Site_Address_EN__c.

OperatorContractItem.description: INTERMED: a contract with a licensed operator. Matched by License_Request__c + Operator_Trade_License_No__c.

DocumentItem.description: A file for one slot of the application. In the same call as the application item, reference it with EPG_License_Request__c = @{NewLicenseRequest.id}; in a later call send applicationId__c = the applicationId from the create response. Refused when Document_Type is not expected; format, size and expiry validated against the catalogue rules. Send either content (base64, files up to about 4 MB) or EPG_File_Id__c (a file uploaded first through POST /services/data/v60.0/sobjects/ContentVersion, any size).

EPG_License_Request__c.description: @{NewLicenseRequest.id} when sent in the same call as the application item

applicationId__c.description: The applicationId returned by the create response, when sent in a later call

fileName.description: With extension; the extension is checked against acceptedFormats

EPG_File_Id__c.description: Id returned by the ContentVersion upload (068...) or its ContentDocumentId (069...): the file is linked to the slot and validated by its real size and extension; no content needed

PricingRequest.description: Legacy quotation envelope. Only quotationRequest.appIdentifier.applicationId is needed for a new-regulation application; the other fields are stored for audit.

applicationId.description: The applicationId returned by the create response (LR-xxxxx, issued by Salesforce)

PricingResponse.description: Same shape as the legacy pricing response. For a new-regulation application every item is one fee line of the catalogue quote.

invoiceId.description: Payment advice id once raised (Pending Payment), else null

quotationStatus.description: Approved = ready to pay; Paid = already settled

items.description: One per fee line; the sum of totalAmount is the amount to pay. Empty when the product has no application fee.

itemId.description: Id of the fee line (EPG_Request_Item__c), stable across calls while the quote is unchanged

StatusResponse.description: Legacy envelope plus the "application" node for new-regulation applications.

status.description: 200, or 404 when the application id is unknown (the HTTP status is 404 as well)

decision.description: Legacy node: code 0 in progress, 1 approved/issued, 2 information requested, 3 rejected; status = applicant status

ApplicationStatus.description: The three statuses and the facts the portal shows next to them. Internal reviewer identities are never returned (BRD 4.8).

applicationId.description: The id Salesforce issued at creation (LR-xxxxx), returned by the create response

reference.description: Salesforce application number (same value for new-regulation applications)

handledBy.description: Role whose turn it is (Customer, Licence Intake Officer, Technical Reviewer, Financial Reviewer, Legal Reviewer, Sign-off Authority)

agentRequest.description: true when the application came through the agent / assistant channel (isAgent_Request__c on the create)

applicantStatus.description: What the applicant may see (BRD 4.8): Draft | Submitted | Under Review | Information Requested | Approved | Conditional Issuance | Issued | Rejected

details.description: The reviewing officer's comment (null when the officer left it blank, or when no request is open)

documentsToReupload.description: While open: the rejected documents with the reviewer's reason (reviewComment), the same list as /licensing/informationRequest

decision.description: Present once a final decision exists

licence.description: Present once a licence is issued

reviewComment.description: The reviewer's reason when Rejected / Re-uploaded
